name: Gazi Fahim Hasan
title: A Creative SEO Specialist
tagline: Navigating the Web, One Ranking at a Time
bio: I am a results-driven SEO Executive and Computer Science graduate with proven expertise in leading SEO teams, architecting technical search strategies, and accelerating organic traffic. From in-depth crawl audits to high-ROI search campaigns, I engineer search visibility that converts.

status.message: Available for Q1 SEO Projects & Consultations

experience.description: Lead and supervise the SEO team to achieve performance targets. Develop and execute advanced SEO strategies to boost organic visibility, and manage on-page, off-page, and technical SEO operations across international client accounts.

Conduct comprehensive keyword research, competitor gap analysis, and full-scale technical SEO audits. Deliver actionable reporting through Google Analytics 4 and Search Console, partnering with clients for customized ROI-driven search growth.
Facilitated cross-lingual communication between English and Bangla, assisted senior instructors, and maintained communication chains among diverse professional cohorts.

education.description: Graduated with strong technical foundation in software engineering, algorithms, web technologies, and systems design—empowering a deep algorithmic understanding of search engine crawling and ranking mechanics.

services.title: Technical SEO Architecture
services.shortDesc: Fix crawl errors, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, and indexation bottlenecks.
services.description: Deep-dive diagnostic audits covering XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, server status codes, JS rendering, structured schema data, and mobile Core Web Vitals optimization.

services.title: On-Page & Semantic SEO
services.shortDesc: Strategic content optimization aligned with Google's helpful content systems and search intent.
services.description: Keyword density, semantic LSI mapping, meta tag optimization, internal linking hierarchy, image compression, and content freshness updates that push pages to page one.

services.title: Keyword & Competitor Intelligence
services.shortDesc: Uncover high-intent, low-competition keyword goldmines and reverse-engineer rivals.
services.description: Exhaustive competitor gap analysis identifying top-performing pages, backlink sources, keyword gaps, and high-converting commercial search queries to capture market share.

services.title: Off-Page & Authority Building
services.shortDesc: Earn high-authority, contextual backlinks that establish undeniable domain authority.
services.description: White-hat outreach, digital PR, brand citation building, and broken link reclamation that boost domain rating and sustain resilient search rankings against algorithm updates.
